{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && python3 - <<'PYEOF'\np=\"specs/001-transactions/checklists/requirements.md\"\ns=open(p).read()\nold=\"\"\"- Items marked incomplete would require spec updates before
  `$speckit-plan`; none are incomplete. One carried-forward open item:
  Claim-A candidate extension (put recency refresh on overwrite) to be
  resolved in clarify/plan.\"\"\"\nnew=\"\"\"- Items marked incomplete would require spec updates before
  `$speckit-plan`; none are incomplete. Carried-forward open items:
  (1) Claim-A candidate extension (put recency refresh on overwrite) to
  be resolved in clarify/plan; (2) Claim-A round-2 resize expiry
  clarification (R07/R08 referenced but not yet defined) - recorded as
  assumption, revisit if a TTL/expiry milestone lands.
- Milestone 2 validation run 2026-10-17: spec.md updated to retain R01-R03
  and add R04 (invalidate_many any/all; empty requested tags remove zero
  in either mode; invalid mode/tags rejected before mutation;
  invalidate(tag) stays compatible), R05 (resize validates positive
  non-bool int first; survivors keep LRU order; shrink evicts LRU; grow
  evicts nothing; failed resize preserves all state; maxsize property
  reports capacity), R06 (generator tags consumed once; detached returns
  incl. nested structures). Added user stories 4-5, FR-014..FR-019,
  SC-006, and 8 new edge cases. Superseded design-note prose (empty
  all-mode matches every key; resize may flush) explicitly overridden per
  R04/R05. `grep -c 'NEEDS CLARIFICATION' spec.md` -> 0. All 16 checklist
  items remain [x].\"\"\"\nif old in s:\n    s=s.replace(old,new,1)\n    open(p,\"w\").write(s)\n    print(\"checklist updated: True\")\nelse:\n    print(\"checklist updated: False (anchor not found)\")\n    print(repr(s[-600:]))\nPYEOF"}
